column1: # end4pC keybinds. One bind per line, fields separated by a tab:
#   category  keys  action  argument  name  flags  repeat
# action: exec shell close float fullscreen fullscreen_state focus_dir move_dir workspace movews movews_silent movews_plain special movespecial drag resize layout lua
# flags: l works when locked, r repeats when held, e on key release, m mouse bind, n keeps the key for the app, h alternate (hidden by default), d disabled
# repeat: num / pad run the line for the number row / the keypad (the # in keys and argument is the digit 1..10)
# Edit these in Tools > Keybinds. Your own copy lives in ~/.config/hypr/keybinds.tsv (delete it to go back to this one).
